paragraphs: Ohpynez runs a survey platform built on open-ended questions rather than preselected multiple choice options. The stated methodology uses non-categorical open-ended questions to define and compare opinions with ordinal data. Respondents rate their level of agreement or disagreement with each others' answers, and the results are displayed in aggregate.

The product is described as free to use, with no limited trial or subscription to sign up for. Charges apply only to premium features that limit potential respondents to a predetermined list of individuals and restrict access to some or all of the results. The pages name the audience as individuals, researchers, and organizations of all sizes that need exploratory, primary or secondary research.
Ohpynez minimizes the demographic information that can be collected and has safeguards intended to help ensure anonymity and safety.

quote.text: Free to use actually means free to use: there is no limited trial or subscription to sign up for.
